translation: Non-toxic. It grows in Guiyang. The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 牛扁 (niúbiǎn), flavor bitter, slightly cold. It governs heat-qi of the sores of the body's skin (身皮瘡熱氣), may be made into a bathing decoction (浴湯), kills cattle lice and small insects (牛虱小蟲), and also treats cattle disease (療牛病).
